## Scope and cadence, from the owner (2026-10-25)

田騏, 10:20:45Z, in the same project thread, verbatim and untranslated, confirming the two refinements the thread proposed at 10:05Z:

> 所以需要更新 skills，而且fable 复核应该只针对pr中的重要文件对吧

The thread answered yes to both. Add them to "What to change":

5. **Scope = the surface files, not the whole diff.** The full review covers the PR files that sit on the three surfaces (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test, `skills/**` and `.claude/skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`). Lockfiles, generated output, changesets and prose docs elsewhere in the same PR are not reviewed. The reviewer still **reads** the code those files cite, to judge them, but does not review that code. Evidence from PR #25717: the round-2 review's must-fix (HotCRM's companion packages must declare sales, or the module's install and the app's upgrade are refused) and its boot-order finding came only from reading `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts#installPackage` and the `sys_packages` hydrate in `packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts`. This matches the contract review's existing scope rule (the `reviewFace` hits plus the files their hunks assert).
6. **Cadence.** One independent full review per substantive head. A commit that only applies a review's findings gets a delta review of that commit by the same reviewer. The cycle stops at the first round with no must-fix item. Measured on PR #25717: round 1 (independent review of the Fable re-draft, after two contract-review PASSes) found 3 must-fix; round 2 (review of the head that applied them, `2bf30f03`) found 1 must-fix and 6 should-fix; each full review cost roughly 185k to 270k tokens and 10 to 18 minutes.

Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Scope and tier

File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (the detail: full-review depth, independence, scope = surface files only, cadence, the carrier of the record — a fourth item ④ in the `## Contract review` record is the seat's recommendation, so one record shape stays), `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (the `--brief-template` gains the ④ adversarial instruction and the surface-file scope rule; `--template` gains the ④ heading if the record carries it; its `--self-test` pins the new lines — keep the mirror rule the file's docblock states), `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (the policy passage that states who reviews a governed or published surface gains this order as a clause IN THE SAME LINE or by rewording a neighbour — the file sits at its line ceiling 319 with headroom 0; ⛔ no new line, ⛔ no ceiling raise; state in the body whether `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**` already fall under SKILL.md's governed-rules-text definition and add only what is missing). Line ratchet (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`): `contract-review.md` is 49 lines under a ceiling of 60 — eleven lines of room, spend fewer; `SKILL.md` 319/319. `references/_index.md` only if a generator owns it. Tier S (`.claude/**`, the register's Tier S row): the seat lands it after the contract review PASS and its own `## 席位核对` — you never ready, arm, enqueue or approve (os-dev.md rule 2). Tier of your thread: `dispatch-gates --tier .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` prints MANDATORY `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (clause ①, 2026-08-20) — the seat's claim carries it.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at `00a4593a` (seat, 2026-10-27T05:21Z): **holds.**
1. `contract-review.md` 〈复核归属与资格(按面)〉 L5–L42 names the four faces and the ①②③ record shape; nothing in it asks whether the design works for its first consumer. The surface definition the card wants (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test; `skills/**` and `.claude/skills/**`; `docs/adr/**`) must be reconciled with the existing 复核面 = 契约四面 line, not duplicated beside it: say which of the three are already a face and which this PR adds.
2. `record-recognisers.mjs` L886 prints `### ③ Boundary flags` in `--template`; `--brief-template` (L9, `contractReviewBriefLines` L33) lists the three judged items; `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` runs its `--self-test` in `Lint` (lint.yml L1165). Every new template line is pinned by a self-test case, as the file's docblock demands (the self-test DRIVES the recogniser rather than restating it).
3. Evidence the text may cite, from the card: PR #25717's two full-review rounds (3 must-fix, then 1 must-fix + 6 should-fix; 185k–270k tokens, 10–18 min each) — cite the card, ⛔ do not restate the findings in the skill.
4. The seat's own current practice already runs the reviewer wide (the brief tells it to read every cited file and the live tree); the PR should make that the written rule, not invent a second review record.
5. No open PR touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` or `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (scan at 2026-10-27T05:21Z).

### Card-specific clauses

- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran` — `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:role-word`, `check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` are the family; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-25765`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #25765` (behind the harness's two attribution lines), then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (Tier S: 需要你做的 = 无,席位落地), then What changes (every before/after line fenced, byte-exact), the line-count table per file, Tests, Acceptance notes, Verification. ⛔ No model name anywhere in commits or PR; the model-free trailer pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them.
- ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee. ⛔ No GitHub MCP tools, reads included.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #25765 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations`, `line_budget` and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, the head sha, the report comment id and the premise verdict; then stay subscribed to the PR for the contract review's verdict and a possible patch round.
